description: Every category new listings are filed under, with its slug; departments, slugs that cover every category in them (furniture, fitness); and older_categories, slugs that older live listings still carry, which search accepts too. Use a slug with listing_resolve_category, the pricing tools or search to avoid guessing. A category's listings can be stored under an older slug (Peloton Bike's under peloton-bike-2nd-gen), which searching the category covers. A department does not cover older_categories: to include them, add their slugs to the search's category list (sofas,living-room-sets).
